subject: general
question: Ebony and Mahogany trees are found in which type of forests?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical evergreen forests**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tropical evergreen forests are dense forests found near the equator and close to the tropics. They have a warm and wet climate throughout the year.
 
• Ebony and Mahogany trees are typically found in tropical evergreen forests due to the high rainfall and humidity that support their growth.
 
• These forests have a multi-layered structure with an abundance of different species of trees, shrubs, climbers, and epiphytes.
 
• The biodiversity in tropical evergreen forests is extremely rich, making them some of the most productive and valuable ecosystems on Earth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mangrove Forests**

 
 
• Mangrove forests are coastal ecosystems found in tropical and subtropical regions. They are characterized by salt-tolerant trees and shrubs that grow in intertidal zones.
 
• These forests are crucial for protecting coastlines from erosion and providing habitats for a wide variety of marine life.
 
 
 
• **Tropical Deciduous Forests**
 
 
• Tropical deciduous forests, also known as monsoon forests, are found in regions with seasonal rainfall. Trees in these forests shed their leaves during the dry season to conserve water.
 
• These forests are less dense than tropical evergreen forests and are home to a variety of animal species.
 
 
 
• **Montane Forests**
 
 
• Montane forests are found in mountainous regions where the altitude affects the climate and vegetation. These forests can be divided into lower montane and upper montane forests.
 
• They are characterized by cooler temperatures and different flora compared to tropical forests, including coniferous trees at higher elevations.
